scope: recommendation/review evidence contracts, point-in-time controls, cross-stage lineage, executable evals and regression guards; active 2026-10-12 business stage/lease are not advanced by this maintenance action
problem: FreezeCard prohibited explicit future use but did not mechanically reject a caller-supplied public/market cutoff later than the owner premarket boundary.
SourceReceipt could claim FULL while expected link/image counts were unknown, and source packages lacked a mandatory latest-admitted knowledge-availability timestamp bound to FreezeCard.
Calendar events were exempted from one event availability guard, conflating future occurrence time with when the market first knew the calendar fact.
Universe completeness depended materially on all_event_nodes_exhausted and omission booleans without deterministic reconciliation to IndustryResearch nodes and eligible stock mappings.
U1 subset U0 was protected, but U0 was not mechanically required to equal active Universe and U3 execution candidates were not mechanically required to descend from U1.
why_not_peers was optional at the final candidate schema even though comparative selection is a durable user requirement.
Post-close attribution membership and RecallGrade counts could be caller-supplied without recomputation from the frozen recall cassette/outcome package.
LearningAudit and N_A RuleProposal could close without an explicit reason, and proposal/replay status could be incoherent.
counterexamples: A FreezeCard with 15:00 Asia/Shanghai cutoffs and post_freeze_data_allowed=false could previously satisfy schema shape even though it was not a premarket freeze.
A FULL P01 receipt could omit expected link/image counts entirely and therefore avoid completeness reconciliation.
A source retrieved later could admit a 09:15 item without a source-level content_max_available_at field even if the downstream Event Ledger later used time guards.
Universe could self-report all_event_nodes_exhausted=true while silently omitting an eligible stock mapping discovered in IndustryResearch.
An execution plan could introduce a ticker that was never in U1, allowing a high-conviction narrative to bypass broad recall.
Post-close attribution could mark a frozen-U1 ticker as not in U1, or type recall hits independently, contaminating learning metrics.

The first new integrity test itself used model_copy(update=...) with unvalidated dicts and failed for a fixture-type error; the guard was retained and the test was corrected rather than weakening production logic.

point_in_time: FreezeCard requires timezone-aware cutoffs on the trading date and rejects cutoffs after 09:14:59 when auction_used=false or 09:24:59 when auction_used=true.
FULL SourceReceipt requires explicit link/image expected/read counts and content_max_available_at.
Source completion can be audited directly against FreezeCard; post-freeze content/published timestamps are rejected.
Calendar EventCard.available_at is no longer exempt from freeze availability checks.
research_and_execution_lineage: IndustryResearch remains the many-to-many research substrate; Universe is the stock-level active main-board view.
Every research node must be mapped or explicitly node-excluded; every eligible mapped ticker must be included or explicitly excluded with reason.
U0 must equal active Universe; U3 execution candidates must descend from U1.
Execution candidates require unique ticker/slot and mandatory why_not_peers.
review_and_learning_lineage: Attribution in_u0/in_u1 flags are checked against frozen RecallPool and outcome-category sets reconcile to MarketOutcome.
RecallGrade knowable denominator and U0/U1 hits are recomputed from attribution.
LearningAudit without hypotheses requires no_rule_change_reason; RuleProposal N_A requires no_change_reason; proposal/replay statuses must be coherent.
eval_and_regression: E04 source completeness/point-in-time, E05 Universe/U0 lineage and E08 review grading moved from SPEC_ONLY to executable contract evals.
Controller-level tests prove self-reported PASS is forced back to REVISE for post-freeze source content, incomplete Universe and U3 outside U1.
Static audit now guards point-in-time, Universe/U0/U1/U3, frozen review grading and replay lineage markers in addition to existing authority/mirror/auditor guards.

second_order_challenge: Do not collapse IndustryResearch to one row per ticker: cross-event/node mappings are real research evidence. Deduplication belongs to the stock-level active Universe view, while IndustryResearch preserves the many-to-many substrate.
Do not infer trading performance from stronger contracts. These changes prove integrity of covered decision inputs/lineage, not alpha or profitability.
The current 09:14:59 no-auction cutoff matches the active owner contract and current task; this audit does not claim that literal time is an immutable exchange rule for every future mode.

Outcome five-pool semantics may overlap (for example a strong-stock pool can overlap another category), so this repair does not impose naive equality between every pool_count and the exclusive MarketOutcome.result taxonomy.
Repository tests cannot substitute for a real live-source adapter, independent reviewer, replay runner or durable hosted checkpoint.
